verdict.rationale: The evidence only hints at in-app voice and video: the homepage says 'talk, play, and hang out', Nitro lists 'HD video streaming', and the Social SDK mentions DMs and voice chat, but for game integrations, not the Discord client. Nothing documents starting an audio or video call from a channel or DM. Missing for 10: explicit docs on starting voice/video calls from channels and DMs, documentation of in-app call controls, independent or hands-on corroboration.
